franja-cortina: A long layered cut with classic curtain bangs. The hair falls past the shoulders to just below the shoulder blades, with long, soft layers starting around the collarbones. The bangs are parted in the center: shortest in the middle of the forehead, right at brow level, then sweeping outward and growing gradually longer on each side until they reach the cheekbones, blending seamlessly into soft face-framing layers. Light, airy, gently curved bangs with a soft lift at the part; smooth, flowing lengths with softly tapered ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-reta: A long cut with full blunt bangs. A dense fringe falls to just skim the eyebrows, cut in a crisp horizontal line from temple to temple, with slightly softened corners that blend into the sides. The rest of the hair is long, falling to just below the shoulder blades with a full, blunt perimeter and only very subtle long layers for movement. Smooth crown, hair falling sleekly down the back and over the shoulders, polished glossy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-lateral: A medium-length layered cut with side-swept bangs. The hair falls just past the collarbones, with soft layers starting at the chin. A side part sits above the arch of one eyebrow, and the bangs sweep diagonally across the forehead away from the part: shortest near the part, at upper-brow level, and gradually longer toward the opposite temple, where they reach the outer end of the eyebrow and blend into the side layers. Soft, smooth, gently curved bangs with light root lift; lengths with natural movement and softly tapered ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-desfiada: A long layered cut with a textured, feathered fringe. The bangs cover the forehead and fall to brow level, point-cut and thinned so the ends separate into soft, irregular pieces with small gaps between them, slightly longer at the outer edges where they blend into face-framing layers. The hair falls just past the shoulder blades, with visible choppy layers starting at the chin that give movement and light, piecey ends. Relaxed, slightly tousled finish with natural volume at the crown. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-de-lado-longa: A long layered cut with a long side-swept fringe. A deep side part, and the fringe sweeps from the part across the forehead in a smooth, soft diagonal: it starts at brow level near the part and lengthens toward the opposite side, reaching the cheekbone and then blending into long face-framing layers that fall to the jawline and below. The hair falls to mid-back with long, seamless layers and softly tapered ends. Smooth, glossy, swooping finish with lift at the part. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-cortina-longa: A long layered cut with long curtain bangs. The bangs are parted in the center, their shortest point at cheekbone level, and they sweep outward and down to the jawline on each side, forming a soft, open arch that melts into long face-framing layers. The rest of the hair falls to mid-back, with long, seamless layers starting below the chin. Swoopy lift at the part, smooth flowing lengths and softly tapered ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-birkin: A Birkin-style cut: long, slightly undone hair falling past the shoulders to the upper back, with very subtle long layers, paired with full, soft bangs that fall just below the eyebrows, reaching the upper lash line. The fringe is dense but not severe: its edge is softly point-cut and slightly piecey, with a faint natural split in the center and slightly longer pieces at the temples that blend into the sides. Effortless, airy, lived-in finish, smooth crown, no heavy styling. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-reta-cabelo-medio: A medium-length cut with blunt bangs. The hair falls to the collarbones with a full perimeter and light layers starting at the chin for soft movement. The bangs are full and straight across, falling right at the eyebrows, with a clean edge that softens slightly at the corners into the side lengths. Smooth crown, lengths falling forward over the shoulders with the ends gently bevelled under, polished natural finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-cortina-curta: A mid-length layered cut with short curtain bangs. The hair falls just below the collarbones with soft layers. The bangs are short and almost closed: they fall to just above the eyebrows in the center, with only a small split in the middle, then curve outward and get slightly longer toward the outer brows and temples, blending into the side layers. Light, rounded, airy bangs with a soft brushed shape; bouncy lengths with gently tapered ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-cortina-de-lado: A long layered cut with side-parted curtain bangs. The part sits off-center, above the arch of one eyebrow, and divides the fringe into two unequal panels: the larger panel sweeps across the forehead at brow level and curves down past the outer brow to the cheekbone, while the smaller panel curves outward from the part and falls to the cheekbone on its own side. Both panels blend into soft face-framing layers. The hair falls just below the shoulder blades with long, soft layers. Airy lift at the part, smooth flowing lengths with tapered ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-wispy: A long cut with wispy, see-through bangs. The fringe is light and sheer, made of fine, separated strands that fall to the eyebrows with visible gaps of forehead between them; the tips are tapered and feathery, and the outer pieces are slightly longer, blending into soft face-framing layers. The hair falls past the shoulder blades with long, airy layers and lightly tapered ends. Soft, weightless, natural finish with gentle lift at the crown. Keep the natural hair texture.
franjinha-curta: A long cut with baby bangs. A short micro fringe ends around the middle of the forehead, well above the eyebrows, cut across in a clean, straight line with slightly softened, textured tips and enough density to look deliberate and graphic. The rest of the hair falls to just below the shoulder blades with a full, mostly blunt perimeter and only subtle long layers. Smooth crown, lengths hanging sleekly down the back and over the shoulders. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-em-camadas: A long layered cut with full layered bangs. The fringe is built from several lengths: shorter pieces in the center of the forehead at brow level and gradually longer pieces toward the temples that reach the cheekbones, all blended so the bangs look soft, rounded and voluminous rather than flat. The hair falls just past the shoulder blades, with bouncy layers starting at the chin. Round-brushed blowout finish with lift at the roots and crown, lengths with soft movement and slightly curved-under ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-bardot: A 1960s Bardot-style look: long, voluminous hair falling past the shoulder blades with long, soft layers, teased and lifted at the crown for a rounded bouffant height. Long, full curtain bangs are parted in the center, falling to just below the eyebrows in the middle and sweeping outward in two soft curves to the cheekbones, where they blend into the sides. Big, airy, brushed-out volume, softly tousled lengths and a sensual, undone finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-coreana: A long cut with Korean-style air bangs. The fringe is very thin and sheer: a light veil of fine, separated strands falling to the eyebrows, gently curved inward at the tips, with the forehead clearly visible through it. A few slightly longer, thin face-framing strands at the temples fall to the cheekbones. The hair falls past the shoulders to mid-back with soft, subtle long layers and gently curled-under ends. Sleek, soft, delicate finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-bottleneck: A long layered cut with bottleneck bangs. The fringe is short and narrow in the center, just below brow level with a slight split, then flares outward and gets longer on each side, curving around the outer brows down to the cheekbones like the neck of a bottle, and blending into face-framing layers at the jawline. The hair falls past the shoulder blades, with soft layers starting at the chin. Rounded, airy bangs with soft lift; smooth, flowing lengths with tapered ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-com-camadas-no-rosto: A long cut with full bangs blended into face-framing layers. The fringe is full and closed in the center, falling to the eyebrows with a soft edge; at the corners it continues without a break into front layers that step down from the cheekbones to the chin and then to the collarbones. The hair falls past the shoulder blades with long layers. Soft, seamless, polished blowout finish with lift at the crown and the front layers brushed gently outward. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-shag: A shoulder-length 1970s-style shag cut with heavy, full bangs. Many short, choppy layers are concentrated at the crown and around the sides, giving lots of volume on top and lighter, wispy, flicky ends at the shoulder-length perimeter. The bangs are thick, dense and closed across the whole forehead with no center split, falling to just below the eyebrows; their edge is razor-cut into irregular, piecey tips, slightly longer at the temples where they blend into the layers. Tousled, textured, rock-inspired finish with plenty of movement. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-arredondada: A long cut with rounded bangs. The fringe is cut in a soft curve: shortest in the center of the forehead, just above the eyebrows, and curving gradually longer toward the temples, where it reaches the outer ends of the brows. The edge is smooth and dense, brushed into a gentle rounded shape that sits close to the forehead. The rest of the hair falls past the shoulders to the upper back with light layers and soft ends. Smooth, polished, gently bevelled finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-pesada: A very long one-length cut with heavy blunt bangs. The fringe is extra thick and deep, sectioned from far back on the crown, and falls just below the eyebrows, cut perfectly straight across in a dense, solid line with sharp square corners at the temples. The rest of the hair falls to the lower back in one length, with no visible layers and a crisp, blunt perimeter. Sleek, glossy, heavy finish, with the lengths hanging smoothly behind and in front of the shoulders. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-emo: A 2000s emo-style cut: the hair falls just past the shoulders, with many choppy, razored layers that are short and stacked at the crown for volume on top and thin, wispy ends at the perimeter. A long, heavy side-swept fringe starts from a deep side part and sweeps diagonally across the forehead, reaching the cheekbone on the opposite side. The fringe is razor-cut with pointed, piecey tips and smoothed flat, contrasting with the teased, textured crown. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-curta-picotada: A shoulder-length choppy layered cut with short choppy bangs. The fringe is short, ending in the upper half of the forehead well above the eyebrows, cut with an irregular, notched, piecey edge rather than a straight line. The hair falls to just above the shoulders, with lots of choppy layers, separated textured ends and volume at the crown. Edgy, undone, tousled finish with lots of movement. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-assimetrica: A long cut with an asymmetric diagonal fringe. The bangs are cut bluntly in a clean, slanted line across the forehead: shortest at one temple, at mid-forehead height, and gradually longer toward the other side, where they reach just below the eyebrow. Dense, sharp, precise edge, styled flat and smooth. The rest of the hair falls past the shoulders to the upper back with a blunt perimeter and minimal layers. Graphic, modern, polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
franja-em-v: A long cut with V-shaped bangs. The fringe is cut so its edge forms a pointed V: shortest at the outer corners near the temples, at mid-forehead height, and angling down to a point in the center of the forehead, just above the space between the eyebrows. Dense, crisp, precise edge, styled smooth and flat. The rest of the hair falls past the shoulder blades in a long, mostly blunt length with subtle layers. Sleek, glossy, edgy alternative finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
